newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CVNE IPO price 3,900 ptas per share-CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CVNE IPO price 3,900 ptas per share-CNMV.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana (CVNE) said on Tuesday the price of its 22.46 percent initial public offering would be 3,900 pesetas a share, the Stock Market Commission CNMV said.
The price was valid for both the retail and institutional tranches.
On Monday, CVNE closed its offer after just one day, although it was initially scheduled to run until July 16.
The subscription period for the institutional tranche runs from July 9 through 11. Irrevocable bids for retail shares will also be accepted.
